title: Easy Ender Additions
description: Adds Ender and Blaze ores + processing to allow for peaceful progression.
body:
# Easy Ender Additions

Easy Ender Additions is a progression mod designed to make Ender and Blaze resources obtainable through mining, processing, and automation. It's super useful for players who play on Peaceful difficulty or who prefer tech based progression over mob farming.

Instead of hunting Endermen or farming Blazes, players can now mine special ores, refine them into fragments, and craft or automate their way to Ender Pearls and Blaze Powder.

## 🔮Ender Ores

Easy Ender adds three Ender Ore variants.

### They all:
- Require an Iron pickaxe or better
- Support Silk Touch
- Drop Ender Fragments
- Give experience when mined
- Emit ender particles and sound

### Ender Ore (Overworld)
- Spawns between Y -64 and Y 12
- Vein size: 3
- Veins per chunk: 5
- Drops 0.2 XP

![Ender Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dd8000fea5250b7a0e55dcdf4b31e2ec0cb9272.png)

### Deepslate Ender Ore
Spawns in the deepslate layers and behaves the same as Ender Ore

![Deepslate Ender Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb436dc86c165830a52d04c91d9a1c20c43db450.png)

### End Ender Ore
- Spawns in The End
- Vein size: 8
- Veins per chunk: 25
- Drops 0.2 XP

![End Ender Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dca37001af8d5cf9b8d2211dcfcb478f14bc1e86.png)

The End is intended to be the main late game source of Ender materials.

All ores can be silk touched and smelted/blasted, milled to make dust, or crushed by Create's crushing wheels to make slurry.

![Ender Ore Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e740b4a9cf50130910d49fd5108eeef1353950e.png)![Ender Ore Blasting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6396a9a762ce5653b7dd74f903e8d57e0543e25a.png)
  

## 🔥Blaze Ores

Easy Ender also adds Blaze Ore to allow Peaceful mode players to obtain Blaze Powder.

They all:
- Require an Iron pickaxe or better
- Support Silk Touch
- Drop Blaze Fragments
- Give experience when mined
- Emit fire particles and sound

### Blaze Ore (Overworld)
- Spawns between Y -64 and Y 8
- Vein size: 3
- Veins per chunk: 3
- Drops 0.4 XP

![Blaze Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62a1200a6f454d897721c0e6306c9fb4b5f07462.png)

### Deepslate Blaze Ore
Spawns in deepslate and behaves the same as Blaze Ore

![Deepslate Blaze Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd250b75188c2583eafe457753285ce97cbc9304.png)

### Nether Blaze Ore
- Spawns in the Nether
- Vein size: 7
- Veins per chunk: 10
- Drops 0.4 XP
- Has a chance to drop extra Blaze Fragments

![Nether Blaze Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b41c85f29b1956dae401ce08d27ee97125be0d63.png)

The Nether is intended to be the main source of Blaze materials.

All ores can be silk touched and smelted/blasted, milled to make dust, or crushed by Create's crushing wheels to make slurry.

![Blaze Ore Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/502e0b51fdb5619c47c39826405c78e5880e8004.png)![Blaze Ore Blasting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a78405a7320385e60a8e21b88198a7074d96157.png)

  

## 🧩Fragments and Dust

### Ender Fragments
Obtained by mining Ender Ore or smelting Ender Dust.
9 Ender Fragments can be crafted into 1 Ender Pearl.
![Ender Fragment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0df186243a95b76bff6ba8e5467f2484698363f8.png)

Ender Fragments can also be eaten. Doing so teleports the player randomly (within loaded chunks), plays Enderman effects, deals Ender Pearl style damage, applies nausea for 10 seconds, and cannot kill the player (min 1/2 a heart). Used to get you out of trouble at a drop of a hat.

### Blaze Fragments
Obtained by mining Blaze Ore or smelting Blaze Dust.
9 Blaze Fragments craft into vanilla Blaze Powder.
![Blaze Fragment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b6b66bd9da0a8875a9eb980ecc0672cfc1e9b4a.png)

### Ender Dust and Blaze Dust
![Ender Dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d826f44a93052ff97f27fb0608c39a1bbb747947.png)![Blaze Dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13e761c9d332b25dbc05539bb935a1fa9044f1f4.png)

Dust is created by washing slurry or by milling fragments.
Dust can be smelted or blasted into fragments.



## ⚙ Slurry and Automation

When using Create or similar tech mods:
Crushing Ender Ore produces Ender Slurry

![Ender Slurry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86355795c2d8b9587e9771b1b124672f33241425.png)

Crushing Blaze Ore produces Blaze Slurry

![Blaze Slurry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8316659b1b47936edcc6f5c846fbd842bb0d90d9.png)

Washing slurry produces 2 dust of the corresponding type.
Smelting or blasting dust produces fragments.

This allows Silk Touch ore doubling and full automation.



## 🔨Crafting
9 Ender Fragments → 1 Ender Pearl

![Ender Fragments to Pearls Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/529c28cb81b1b317102c61646d0d6b7456fcbc53.png)

9 Blaze Fragments → 1 Blaze Powder

![Blaze Fragments to Powder Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/590533052ab8ffbb85be1016e05a2a1aac8206d5.png)

8 Ender Fragments + 1 Blaze Powder → 1 Eye of Ender

![Ender Fragments and Blaze Powder to Ender Eye Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b74b46c9152c75e9020de5046a83d3eab72a32.png)

All smelting recipes work in regular furnaces and blast furnaces.



## 🏆Advancements

### Ender

- Fragmented Reality: Obtain Ender Fragments or Ender Ore
- Spontaneous Relocation: Eat an Ender Fragment and survive
- Into the Thick of It: Obtain Ender Slurry

### Blaze

- Hey Hot Stuff: Obtain Blaze Fragments or Blaze Ore
- Now We’re Cooking: Obtain Blaze Slurry



## ⚙ Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API



## 📦Mod Compatibility

Designed to work with:

Create - Crushing, milling, washing and bulk blasting.
Any tech mod that processes ores
Mods that respect vanilla loot tables



## ❌ Incompatibilities

No known incompatibilities yet.
Please report issues on [GitHub Issues Page](https://github.com/Tomaszenko7/easy_ender/issues).
